description: LiteLLMModel is a single model served by one or more LiteLLMProxy instances.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: LiteLLMModelSpec defines a single proxy model_list entry.

info.description: Info is the typed model_info block for this model.

extra.description:
Extra holds any further model_info keys, merged verbatim under the typed
fields (which win on conflict).

maxInputTokens.description: MaxInputTokens is the context window size (max_input_tokens).

maxOutputTokens.description: MaxOutputTokens is the maximum completion length (max_output_tokens).

maxTokens.description: MaxTokens is the model's total token budget (max_tokens).

mode.description: Mode is the endpoint mode, e.g. "chat", "messages", "embedding".

modelName.description: ModelName is the public name clients call (model_list[].model_name).

params.description: Params is the litellm_params block for this model.

additional.description:
Additional holds any further litellm_params, merged verbatim under the typed
fields (which win on conflict).

apiBase.description: APIBase is the provider base URL. Mutually exclusive with APIBaseRef.

apiBaseRef.description: APIBaseRef sources the provider base URL from a Secret. Mutually exclusive with APIBase.

key.description: Key within the Secret holding the value.

apiKey.description: APIKey is a literal or os.environ/VAR API key. Prefer APIKeyRef for real secrets.

apiKeyRef.description: APIKeyRef sources the provider API key from a Secret. Mutually exclusive with APIKey.

key.description: Key within the Secret holding the value.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion for providers that require it (e.g. Azure).

dropParams.description: DropParams drops request params the provider does not support instead of erroring.

model.description: Model is the underlying provider model identifier, e.g. "openai/glm-5.2".

rpm.description: RPM caps requests-per-minute for this deployment.

tpm.description: TPM caps tokens-per-minute for this deployment.

proxyRef.description:
ProxyRef explicitly binds this model to a LiteLLMProxy by name in the same
namespace. When set it takes precedence over any proxy's modelSelector.

status.description: LiteLLMModelStatus reports which proxies currently include this model.

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest observations of the model's state.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.
